title: Six Step Commutation
text: Generate switching sequence for six-step commutation of brushless DC (BLDC) motor, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Position Unit} sets Unit of position input; {Input type} sets the block input type, {Hall Sequence number} sets the hall sequence, {Enable custom commutation} enables Commutation switching parameter and {Commutation switching}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Position Unit
params.values: Unit of position input Per-unit (default) | Degrees | Radians

params.name: Enable custom commutation
params.values: Enable Commutation switching parameter off (default) | on
